abstract: Between August 1983 and April 1996, 53 testicular germ cell tumors in 52 patients were treated at Toranomon Hospital. The average age of the patients was 36.1 years (range 21-89). The affected side was the right side in 24, left in 27 and bilateral in 1 case. Of the 53 tumors 34 (64.2%) were seminoma and 19 (35.8%) were non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT). High ligation orchiectomy was performed in all cases. Of 29 stage I seminomas, post-operative adjuvant radiotherapy was performed in 6 cases prior to 1991. None of these tumors recurred. Two cases of relapses (8.7%) were found among the 23 stage I seminomas followed by surveillance. Of 8 stage I NSGCTs followed by surveillance, 4 (50.0%) tumors which contained embryonal carcinoma element and vascular invasion relapsed within 12 months after orchiectomy. A case of stage IIA seminoma was treated successfully by irradiation. Seven cases of stage II (3 seminomas and 4 NSGCTs) and 8 cases of stage III (1 seminoma and 7 NSGCTs) as well as cases of 6 stage I patients who developed relapse during surveillance were treated by VAB-6 chemotherapy. Of these 21 cases, 11 (52.4%) achieved complete response (CR) and 10 (47.6%) partial response (PR). Salvage surgery and/or additional chemotherapy was successful to bring the 10 PR cases into CR condition. One NSGCT patient, however, died of electrolyte imbalance during the maintenance chemotherapy for disease progression after achieving CR. All 34 patients with seminomas and 18 of the 19 with NSGCTs were alive without evidence of disease after a mean follow up period of 61.1 months (range 4-150 months).
abstract_ja: 1983年8月から1996年4月までに、虎ノ門病院で52例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍53個を治療した。患者の平均年齢は36.1歳（21〜89歳）。患側は右24例、左27例、両側1例。53腫瘍のうち34例（64.2%）がセミノーマ、19例（35.8%）が非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）であった。全例で高位結紮精巣摘除術を施行した。病期Iのセミノーマ29例のうち、1991年以前に6例で術後補助放射線療法を施行した。これらの腫瘍では再発はなかった。監視療法を受けた病期Iのセミノーマ23例中2例（8.7%）に再発がみられた。監視療法を受けた病期INSGCT 8例のうち、胎児性癌成分と脈管侵襲を有する4例（50.0%）が精巣摘除後12カ月以内に再発した。病期IIAのセミノーマ1例は放射線照射により奏効した。病期II 7例（セミノーマ3例、NSGCT 4例）、病期III 8例（セミノーマ1例、NSGCT 7例）、および監視療法中に再発した病期I患者6例は、VAB-6化学療法で治療した。これら21例のうち11例（52.4%）が完全奏効（CR）、10例（47.6%）が部分奏効（PR）であった。PR 10例はサルベージ手術や追加化学療法により完全奏効へ導いた。ただし、NSGCT 1例は完全奏効後の維持化学療法中に電解質異常で死亡した。セミノーマ患者34例全例と、NSGCT患者19例中18例が、平均61.1カ月（4〜150カ月）のフォローアップ後に病変のない状態で生存していた。
